h: Remember and Guard Within the Unity of Anochi

p: In the Zohar Chadash (end of Parshas Yisro) it is stated:
that 'I am' and 'You shall have no'
were said in a single utterance," etc.;
"these are the general principle of the whole Torah;
and all in a single utterance," etc.;
'I am' and 'You shall have no,'" etc.;
"Remember" and "Keep" were said in a single utterance
this we find in the Gemara (Shevuos 20b);
that is, in the first Commandments "Remember" is written,
אֲבָל עִנְיַן אָנֹכִי וְלֹא יִהְיֶה לְךָ
But the matter of "I am" and "You shall have no,"
of which it said that they were said in one utterance
that in the general scheme of the words of Torah,
הוּא כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתַב בַּזֹּהַר חָדָשׁ אַחַר כָּךְ
it is as the Zohar Chadash wrote afterward:
"I am" includes all the positive mitzvos,
And Shabbos, which is the general principle of the Torah
(כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב זֹהַר חֵלֶק ב צב, א)
"Remember" is the general principle of the positive mitzvos,
that one must sanctify the day upon its entrance;
וְשָׁמוֹר הוּא כְּלַל הַמִּצְוֹת לֹא תַעֲשֶׂה
and "Keep" is the general principle of the prohibitions.
In the first Commandments "Remember" is said,
for it is stated in the holy Zohar (there, 92b)
that it is "a place that has no forgetting,
and forgetting has no standing there," etc.;
that is, since he sanctifies the Shabbos upon its entrance,
which is an arousal from below,
אָז הַשֵּׁם יִתְבָּרַךְ מַכְנִיס בּוֹ קְדוּשָּׁתוֹ
then Hashem Yisbarach places His holiness in him,
"to know that I am Hashem who sanctifies you";
and then he will certainly keep the Shabbos,
since he is in the aspect of "Remember,"
And this was said in the first Commandments,
for it is stated (Shir HaShirim Rabbah 1:2):
the study of Torah was implanted in their heart," etc.;
the evil inclination was uprooted from their heart," etc.
But after the deed of the Calf,
when the evil inclination returned to its place,
then "Keep" was said in the second Commandments:
to guard the whole Shabbos day,
שֶׁלֹּא יָבוֹא לִידֵי חִלּוּל שַׁבָּת חַס וְשָׁלוֹם
so as not to come to desecrating Shabbos, Heaven forbid,
since there is an evil inclination
for this is the main power of the evil inclination,
וְהָיָה אִם שָׁכֹחַ תִּשְׁכַּח וְגוֹמֵר (דְּבָרִים ח, יט)
"And it shall be, if you forget," etc. (Devarim 8:19);
"at the time of the evil inclination
there is no one who remembers the good inclination."
And what it said, that "Remember" and "Keep"
הוּא עַל פִּי שֶׁאָמְרוּ בַּזֹּהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ
is according to what they said in the holy Zohar
that at the time of the Giving of the Torah
הָיָה בִּבְחִינַת קוֹל גָּדוֹל וְלֹא יָסָף
it was in the aspect of "a great voice that did not cease" (Devarim 5:19),
and from this there remained to Yisrael after the corruption
וְזֶהוּ עִנְיַן אָנֹכִי וְלֹא יִהְיֶה לְךָ
And this is the matter of "I am" and "You shall have no,"
שֶׁהוּא גַּם כֵּן כְּלַל מִצְוֹת עֲשֵׂה וְלֹא תַעֲשֶׂה
which is also the general principle of positive and negative mitzvos.
For in the pasuk it says (Tehillim 34:15):
first one must turn from evil,
to empty out all the evil from the foolish heart,
וְאָז יוּכַל לְהַכְנִיס דִּבְרֵי תּוֹרָה בַּלֵּב
and then he can bring words of Torah into the heart,
But in the Ten Commandments "I am" is said first,
which is the aspect of "and do good,"
and it should have said first
to uproot the evil inclination from their heart,
so that the study of Torah would be implanted in their heart.
וְעַל זֶה אָמַר בַּזֹּהַר חָדָשׁ הַנִּזְכָּר לְעֵיל
On this the Zohar Chadash cited above said
that "I am" and "You shall have no"
similar to what they said about "Remember" and "Keep":
and the ear cannot hear" (Rosh Hashanah 27a);
and since they were said in one utterance,
and together the evil was uprooted from their heart
and the study of Torah was implanted in their heart.
were also said in one utterance;

p: וְאָמַר אַחַר כָּךְ בַּזֹּהַר חָדָשׁ שָׁם
And afterward the Zohar Chadash says there:
in the general crowning of the letters:
אֶלָּא נ״כ תְּרֵי נוּקְבֵי אִינּוּן וְכוּלֵּי
Rather, Nun-Kaf are two females," etc.;
the secret of all faith," etc.;
Alef is the secret of the middle line,
which takes from all sides," etc.
וּבַזֹּהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ (חֵלֶק ג רנו, ב) אָמַר
And in the holy Zohar (Zohar III 256b) it says:
and in it is Ayin," etc.
פֵּירוּשׁ דְּהָאוֹת כ׳ מוֹרֶה עַל כֶּתֶר
That is, the letter Kaf indicates Keser,
which alludes to the aspect of Atika,
כְּמוֹ שֶׁאָמְרוּ (זֹהַר חֵלֶק ב סד, ב)
"The Hidden Ancient One, most hidden of all,
וְכָאן בַּזֹּהַר חָדָשׁ אָמַר רְמָזִים אֲחֵרִים
And here in the Zohar Chadash it gave other allusions
in the manner of the four letters of Havayah;
and it said "Yud is on high, on high," etc.;
that the letter Yud alludes to Chochmah.
And of the letter Alef it said
that it is the secret of the middle line;
וּכְמוֹ שֶׁכָּתַב בַּזֹּהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ (שָׁם נד, א)
as is written in the holy Zohar (Zohar II 54a)
עַל הַפָּסוּק אָז יָשִׁיר (שְׁמוֹת טו, א)
"And Alef bored through the darkness into Zayin," etc.,
which corresponds to the first utterance
כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב בַּזֹּהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ (חֵלֶק ג יא, ב)
as is written in the holy Zohar (Zohar III 11b):
and ten for the Giving of the Torah."
וּמִשּׁוּם זֶה אָמַר בַּזֹּהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ הַנִּזְכָּר לְעֵיל
Therefore the holy Zohar cited above said
Only here in the Zohar Chadash it said:
that is, even in the second Commandments,
which are in the secret of "Keep," as mentioned above,
אַף שֶׁהֵם מְרַמְּזִים לְמִדַּת אֱמוּנָה לְבַד
although they allude to the attribute of faith alone,
שֶׁאָז כְּבָר נִשְׁאַר רַק קוֹל דְּבָרִים
for by then only "a voice of words" remained,
and that is the attribute of Malchus,
וּכְמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב (זֹהַר חֵלֶק ג רל, א)
"He is Truth and She is Faith."
that is, the aspect of the upper Hei
דְּאוֹת כ׳ מְרַמֵּז עַל ה׳ תַּתָּאָה
for the letter Kaf alludes to the lower Hei.
And it is as they said (in Pesach Eliyahu, Tikkunei Zohar 17b):
"the Supernal Crown is the Crown of Malchus";
so too the attribute of Malchus
that is, since there is an Israelite nation
who recognize the power of His kingship
the yoke of His kingship, may His Name be blessed
עַל יְדֵי זֶה נִכְתָּר הַשֵּׁם יִתְבָּרַךְ
through this Hashem Yisbarach is crowned,
as it were, with the Supernal Crown;
in the manner of what they said in the Midrash
a parable of a king," etc.;
"from when You stood at the sea
and we said song before You with 'Az,'
and recognized the power of His kingship,
and He is called King sitting upon a throne,
and is crowned with the Supernal Crown.
וְאוֹת נ׳ מְרַמֵּז עַל ה׳ עִלָּאָה
And the letter Nun alludes to the upper Hei,
which is the aspect of Binah;
and when it is composed of ten,
then it is the fifty gates of Binah.
And this is the meaning of "two females":
"just as there is a Shechinah below,
so too there is a Shechinah above," etc.
And it said, "Yud is on high, on high,
that is, the Yud truly alludes to Chochmah,
only the crown-tip of the Yud alludes
to what shines forth from the Supernal Crown
and this is the meaning of "on high, on high":
it is "on high, on high, the beginning," etc.
And the Alef, of which it said
that it is the secret of the middle line,
corresponds to the Vav in the Holy Name,
which is the aspect of Tiferes;
and the Vav in the middle,
And on this it said afterward:
that "'Ani' is the secret of the holy covenant," etc.,
the secret of the female," etc.
is the letters of the Name Adnut,
which indicates the root of the Name,
which alludes to the Crown of Malchus
And this is what it said:
"'Ani' is male and female together," etc.
of the Holy One, blessed be He, and His Shechinah.
And this is what the Zohar Chadash said:
"'Anochi' here is the secret of general and particular;
וְהוּא עַל פִּי שֶׁאָמְרוּ (זֹהַר חֵלֶק ג רסד, א)
This is based on what they said (Zohar III 264a):
this is where Havayah is written;
"this is general and this is particular," etc.,
"in the secret of 'Remember' and in the secret of 'Keep.'"
That is, the two matters are included:
"a great voice that did not cease"
which is the aspect of "Remember" and "Keep,"
שֵׁם מָלֵא עַל עוֹלָם מָלֵא וְכוּלֵּי
a full Name over a full world," etc.
That is, throughout the work of Creation
but afterward in the second section,
"These are the generations of the heavens," etc.,
it is written "on the day that Hashem Elokim made";
וְזֶהוּ שֵׁם מָלֵא עַל עוֹלָם מָלֵא
and this is "a full Name over a full world."
That is, the Name Havayah indicates
that He was, is and will be;
וְאַתָּה הוּא עַד שֶׁלֹּא נִבְרָא הָעוֹלָם
"You were before the world was created,
and You are since the world was created."
is not pronounced in this world,
and there is no revelation of this Name,
since one sees that there are forces
to act against His will, may His Name be blessed.
And after the creation of Adam HaRishon
that He is the Master of all the forces;
that is, Havayah is truly Elokim:
just as before the creation of the world,
there is no power besides Him.
Only, then there were only individuals
who recognized the power of His kingship.

who was the handiwork of the Holy One, blessed be He;
and afterward Mesushelach, who saw Adam
"And it came to pass after the seven days,"
"These were the days of mourning for Mesushelach,
to teach you that the eulogy of the righteous," etc.
and we find that the Holy One, blessed be He,
attached His Name to him in his lifetime,
"Blessed be Hashem, the God of Shem,"
and this was written in the Torah.
וְאַחַר כָּךְ יַעֲקֹב רָאָה אֶת שֵׁם
and with Yaakov there had already begun

ז׳ כִּפְּלוּ אֶת כָּל הָעוֹלָם וְכוּלֵּי
But then there were only individuals;
and this is what they said in the Zohar Chadash there:
it was not called 'Hashem your God'
that is, with a closed Mem.
And afterward, at the time of the Giving of the Torah,
when there was a complete nation
who recognized the power of His kingship,
And this is what it said above:
"your God" is in the secret of "Keep."
everything was included in the general,
as it will be in the future,
וְלֹא יְלַמְּדוּ עוֹד אִישׁ אֶת רֵעֵהוּ וְגוֹמֵר
"And they shall no longer teach every man his neighbor," etc.,
from the least of them to the greatest," etc.;
the study of Torah was implanted in their heart, etc.
וּכְמוֹ שֶׁאָמְרוּ (שְׁמוֹת רַבָּה פָּרָשָׁה מו, א)

that there be in them halachos and aggados," etc.,
